caption: The drawing depicts a lace collar, primarily white or light grey in color, positioned centrally on a blank, light beige background. The collar forms a shallow, wide semicircular arc with a pattern of overlapping, elongated leaf-like motifs along its outer edge. Each of these motifs features intricate internal decorations, such as small circular and wavy line designs. The interior section of the collar between the leaf motifs consists of a repeating diamond lattice, with each intersection containing a small round embellishment. The composition is minimal, with the lace collar being the only object, and there is a signature at the lower right side reading "Frank J. Nelson S.M."
title: Lace Collar
